alerts: notebook-5 calendar (20/month, 240/yr, 240-min cooldown, TH_CAL); dev = recomputed, holdout = notebook-11 saved alarms

audit.episodes: events with breach gaps <= 72 h form one episode; episode-level hit counts under the same nulls
audit.regime_matched: each alert moved to a random minute of the same RV decile within +-30 days, at least 240 min from the original; 5000 draws
audit.regime_variable: trailing 1440-min std of 1-min log returns, deciles within each period

endpoints.caught: composite = pre + post (reference only, not interpreted)
endpoints.eligibility: pre possible only if onset-to-breach gap < 240 min; post possible only if gap >= 30 min
endpoints.onset_anchored: secondary: alert within 240 min before the 1% onset (one alert per event), regardless of the breach window
endpoints.post: in-progress detection: matched alert 30-240 min before the breach, at or after the 1% onset
endpoints.pre: early warning: matched alert 30-240 min before the 4% breach AND before the 1% onset

holdout_use: post-hoc audit of a locked test; notebook-11 hypotheses and results are not changed
null_primary: circular shift of all alerts by U[7 days, L-7 days], 10000 draws, seed 20261029 (identical to holdout H1)

pooling.test: two-sided sign-flip permutation of cluster sums, 100000 draws

reading.skill: an endpoint shows skill in a period if its one-sided p < 0.05 under the primary null
reading.timing_vs_regime: skill is timing-specific if it also holds under the 4h-1d band and the regime-matched null; regime-level only if it holds only for long shifts

title: Early-warning reliability under capacity constraints (exploratory)
